process-definition.name: Forge SDLC Supermodel
process-definition.description: Scout to Architect to Lead to Smith to QA Candidate Assay to DEV_OPS publish. Serial first; SPLIT holds; publish never force-pushes.

state.label: Ready
state.description: Story is Ready: explicit authorization to execute.

task-node.label: Scout
task-node.description: Volume context gathering only. Rank files, capture signatures verbatim, name must-reads. No design, no edits, no commits.

task-node.label: Architect
task-node.description: Own design truth. Frozen contract for Lead: scope, constraints, architecture, acceptance, Assay plan. No implementation.

task-node.label: Lead PRE
task-node.description: Validate frozen contract vs repository reality. Choose cheapest sound shape: SOLO, SMITH, SPLIT:n (Hold-gated), HOLD. No implementation.

decision.label: Lead Execution Gate
decision.description: Lead PRE judgment. SOLO builds directly; SMITH delegates once; SPLIT and HOLD park on forge_hold.

task-node.label: Lead Implement
task-node.description: Lead SOLO implementation. Build frozen contract, verify in frozen test policy, create exact candidate. Stop on architecture defect.

task-node.label: Smith
task-node.description: Implement frozen contract and Lead assignment. One coherent assignment; create candidate commit. Never review own diff.

task-node.label: Lead POST
task-node.description: Integrate Smith candidate vs frozen contract. May edit and re-commit. May STOP on defect. Never weaken acceptance or Assay.

decision.label: Lead Integration Gate
decision.description: Lead POST judgment. ASSAY hands exact integrated candidate to verification; HOLD parks on forge_hold.

decision.label: Candidate Gate
decision.description: Exact-candidate invariant: Assay verifies ONLY the recorded candidate, never a fallback base. Missing parks on forge_hold.

task-node.label: Candidate Assay
task-node.description: QA Candidate Assay operation. Deterministic, model-free: ONLY the immutable packet plan in the exact candidate worktree.

decision.label: Assay Gate
decision.description: Assay verdict. PASS to DEV_OPS publish; FAIL, violation, SHA mismatch, or missing plan parks on forge_hold.

task-node.label: Publish
task-node.description: DEV_OPS accepted-candidate publish. Safe non-force fast-forward of exact assayed candidate only. Never force-push.

decision.label: Publish Gate
decision.description: Mainline safety. Clean fast-forward completes; advanced origin/main conflicts to forge_hold.

end-state.label: Story Complete
end-state.description: Accepted candidate published; story Complete with durable run evidence.

end-state.label: Forge Hold
end-state.description: Human boundary. Lead veto, missing candidate, failed Assay, or publish conflict. Paused, resumable; never auto-retried.
